predictedBugs: A malformed RPC response could mix rows and counts from different bounds.
An out-of-range page could render an empty window instead of clamping to the final page.
A boolean or caller-supplied support capability could authorize work without an auditable database grant ID.
Memory pagination could drift from live search, scope, ordering, or Smart List semantics.
edgeCases: Empty result sets retain exact zero counts and a valid first-page state.
Active aliases are removed by the canonical RPC without invoking exhaustive identity-map reads.
Archived reads ignore Smart Lists and return zero active scope counts.
Revoked, absent, or identity-less support grants remain ordinary assistant authority.
